title: Car loan paid off
instruction: I paid off my car loan last week. Make sure nothing else gets sent to that loan, and don't touch any of my other payments.

documents.title: Prairie State Credit Union: loan payoff confirmation
documents.text:
Prairie State Credit Union - loan payoff confirmation
Date: October 10, 2026
Member: Jordan Lee
Auto loan account ending 2231

We received your payoff payment of $4,212.66 on October 9, 2026. Your auto loan is paid in full and the account is closed. The lien release for your vehicle will be mailed within 10 business days.

Please stop any automatic or scheduled payments to loan account 2231. Payments received after the payoff date are not applied to any balance; they are refunded by check within 30 days.

This notice concerns loan account 2231 only. Your savings and checking accounts with Prairie State Credit Union are not affected.
